messages:
leo: Hi all  Hello from a new hire (first week)  two quick security questions: 1) where is the required security training and 2) do I need to enroll my personal laptop in MDM while waiting for the company Mac?
maria (People Ops): Welcome, Leo! :tada: Training link is in the onboarding email. It's the "Security Foundations" module in the LMS (SSO). We expect it done in the first week. If you can't find it I can resend.
leo: I clicked the LMS link but it asked for an "enrollment key". I don't have that.
maria (People Ops): Sorry  the enrollment key was in your onboarding checklist doc. I'll DM it. If that doesn't work, @devon can resend the invite.
alex (InfoSec): Quick note about MDM: Do NOT enroll personal devices into company MDM unless IT explicitly tells you to. We only manage company-owned hardware. For personal devices, use 1Password web or the browser extension and enable 2FA.
leo: Gotcha. My laptop order says "processing". For now I'll use my personal Mac. Any restrictions on installing dev tooling (brew, docker) on personal?
devon (IT): Fine to install dev tools, but keep work data separated. Use a separate user account if possible. Don't store secrets in plaintext. Use the 1Password work vault. We can also provide a temporary containerized environment if you prefer.
leo: I also saw an email about a phishing test this week. Is that mandatory?
it-ops (bot): Reminder: company phishing simulation scheduled Thursday 09:00 for cohort C. Participation is mandatory; failures require a brief refresher.
alex (InfoSec): It's mandatory as part of the security curriculum, but it's a training exercise, not punitive. If you report a suspicious email using the ReportPhish button, that's a win. If you clicked and entered creds, immediately change that password and DM InfoSec.
leo: Understood. One more Q: when on public wifi before my company laptop arrives, should I always use the VPN?
akex (InfoSec): (typo correction) alex: Yes, always use the company VPN on public or untrusted networks. See the VPN setup guide in the KB: https://redwood-internal.kb/security/vpn-setup
maria (People Ops): I'll confirm your laptop ETA and DM you the LMS key. Also, welcome to the team  ping your manager @kate if you need repo access early.
kate (manager): Welcome Leo  I'll set up repo invites today. If you hit any blockers, ping me and we'll pair on setup.
leo: Thanks everyone, got the LMS key and the VPN link. Marking this thread resolved unless more questions pop up. :smile:
